contentPattern.structure: dynamic grid built from query-index.json (image + linked title + description per indexed page)

suitableFor: section listing grids that should update automatically as pages are added/removed (magazine 'All Articles', article feeds, catalog listings)
any flat grid of a section's child pages driven by the query index
notSuitableFor: hand-curated grids where the author picks specific cards (use cards-teaser)
grids requiring per-item category filtering not present in the query index (e.g. the adventures category tabs)
single feature with side-by-side layout (use columns-featured)

notes: Data-driven variant of cards-teaser. Reads query-index.json (built by helix-query.yaml), filters rows to a section prefix (authored cell, or auto-detected from the current path when empty), and delegates rendering to cards-teaser for full style/behaviour reuse. DA project, so no _cards-index.json model file. Add/remove a page in the section and the grid updates once the index rebuilds.
